articles.title: Dallas Fed warns tokenized deposits could strip $700 billion from U.S. banks' lending capacity
articles.snippet: Programmable deposits and AI agents may enable instantaneous, automated bank switching for higher yields, driving up bank funding costs.

articles.title: 'The Government Doesn't Own Our Data': Prosecuted GrapheneOS User
articles.snippet: Samuel Tunick, facing five years over a wiped phone, said he was secretly placed on a watch list as a suspected terrorist.
